description: 52-case held-out evaluation dataset with dual-human ground truth annotation for ReturnOps AI multimodal inspection pipeline.

cases.scenario: Customer unopened return, original shrinkwrap intact
cases.notes: Unbroken factory film, barcode clearly verified.

cases.scenario: Desk lamp returned in sealed retail carton with tape intact
cases.notes: Manufacturer security seal unbroken.

cases.scenario: Face serum in pristine sealed box with tamper sticker
cases.notes: Holographic tamper sticker verified.

cases.scenario: Jigsaw puzzle in original clear shrinkwrap
cases.notes: Shrinkwrap tightly sealed with retail barcode intact.

cases.scenario: Water bottle in original polybag with hangtag attached
cases.notes: Polybag heat-sealed, paper hangtag uncreased.

cases.scenario: USB-C cable in sealed blister pack
cases.notes: Uncut thermoformed blister packaging.

cases.scenario: Microfiber bath towel in sealed manufacturer band
cases.notes: Cardboard wrap undamaged, towel unwashed.

cases.scenario: Whey protein tub with outer neck band & inner pressure seal
cases.notes: Plastic shrink band around neck completely unperforated.

cases.scenario: Laptop box opened, protective screen film intact, all items present
cases.controlled_change: Opened box but pristine laptop with film
cases.notes: Complete set in factory cardboard cradles, no cosmetic blemishes.

cases.scenario: Headphones packaging opened to inspect color, never worn, all cables coiled
cases.notes: Zero scuffs on ear cushions, cables in twist-ties.

cases.scenario: Desk lamp unboxed but base and arm free of any scratches, cables bundled
cases.notes: Lamp lens clean, manual pristine.

cases.scenario: Water bottle unbagged, zero water residue or odors, lid gasket mint
cases.notes: Stainless interior dry and spotless.

cases.scenario: USB-C cable blister opened cleanly, cable untied but pristine gold contacts
cases.notes: Contacts unscratched, jacket white and unmarked.

cases.scenario: Dog leash removed from card, clip mechanism tested, nylon web pristine
cases.controlled_change: Opened leash with zero hair or dirt
cases.notes: Snap hook spring tight, handle foam clean.

cases.scenario: Puzzle box shrinkwrap removed, but inner piece bag sealed
cases.notes: Plastic bag holding pieces is airtight factory sealed.

cases.scenario: Towel unfolded once, label intact, zero stains or lint
cases.notes: Fabric pristine, stitching intact.

cases.scenario: Laptop with minor surface fingerprints, complete accessories
cases.notes: Light keyboard shine, all cables and charger present.

cases.scenario: Headphones with slight headband handling marks, all accessories present
cases.notes: Fully functional, earcups clean, light scuffs on plastic.

cases.scenario: Desk lamp with faint dust and smudge on base, USB cord uncoiled
cases.notes: Minor dust, touch panel responsive.

cases.scenario: Bottle with faint hairline water spots on powder coat, lid functional
cases.notes: Exterior cleanable, no dents.

cases.scenario: Cable with light cord bends from winding, functional connectors
cases.notes: Connectors clean, jacket flexible.

cases.scenario: Leash with light dirt scuff on handle padding, hardware fully intact
cases.notes: Webbing strong, latch oiled and crisp.

cases.scenario: Laptop with minor palm rest scuffs, complete package
cases.notes: Working unit, all cords intact.

cases.scenario: Headphones with slight headband tension stretch, complete box contents
cases.notes: Acoustics normal, all accessories present.

cases.scenario: Lamp with noticeable scratches on plastic neck, but intact and fully functional
cases.notes: Scratches on finish reduce grade to Acceptable. Intact -> liquidate.

cases.scenario: Bottle with exterior paint chips near base, fully watertight
cases.notes: Cosmetic paint wear. Structural integrity preserved -> liquidate.

cases.scenario: Leash with frayed decorative trim threads, main strap solid
cases.notes: Cosmetic thread fraying. No break in core -> liquidate.

cases.scenario: Towel washed multiple times with faded blue color, no rips
cases.notes: Color wash fade, acceptable grade -> liquidate.

cases.scenario: Laptop with shattered cracked LCD screen, complete in box
cases.notes: Severe LCD glass breakage across panel. Damaged -> dispose.

cases.scenario: Headphones with snapped headband and severed internal wiring
cases.notes: Headband broken in two pieces. Damaged -> dispose.

cases.scenario: Desk lamp with cracked acrylic base and broken hinge
cases.notes: Hinge snapped off, loose electrical wires. Damaged -> dispose.

cases.scenario: Water bottle crushed and creased on side, puncture near rim
cases.notes: Vacuum seal breached, wall crushed. Damaged -> dispose.

cases.scenario: Glass dropper bottle broken, liquid spilled in carton
cases.notes: Glass bottle shattered, contents empty. Damaged -> dispose.

cases.scenario: USB-C cable with severed outer jacket and exposed copper strands
cases.notes: Severe cut through cord. Damaged -> dispose.

cases.scenario: Headphones returned with charging case and aux cable, but USB-C charging cable missing
cases.notes: Non-essential cable missing, item good condition -> refurbish.

cases.scenario: Laptop returned with charger brick and power cable, but user manual missing
cases.notes: Non-essential paper manual missing, hardware complete -> refurbish.

cases.scenario: Desk lamp with power cable, but small setup leaflet missing
cases.notes: Non-essential user manual missing -> refurbish.

cases.scenario: Serum bottle and dropper intact, but cardboard outer box/leaflet missing
cases.notes: Non-essential leaflet missing, condition Acceptable -> liquidate.

cases.scenario: Puzzle box with sealed pieces, but reference poster missing
cases.notes: Pieces intact, auxiliary poster missing -> refurbish.

cases.scenario: Laptop returned with manual and cord, but essential AC power adapter absent
cases.notes: Essential charger missing -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Headphones returned with cables and manual, but essential charging case missing
cases.notes: Charging case is essential for model operation -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Desk lamp returned with manual, but essential USB power cable missing
cases.notes: USB power cable is essential component -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Serum bottle returned with leaflet, but essential dropper top missing
cases.notes: Dropper top is essential for hygiene/application -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Water bottle body returned, but essential twist-off lid missing
cases.notes: Lid is an essential component -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Apple Lightning 8-pin connector cable returned instead of USB-C cable
cases.controlled_change: Lightning cable returned instead of USB-C
cases.notes: Connector interface is Apple 8-pin, not USB-C oval receptacle -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Cheap off-brand wired earbuds returned inside WH-1001 box
cases.controlled_change: Wired earbuds returned instead of over-ear headphones
cases.notes: Product inside does not match WH-1001 wireless over-ear form factor -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Plastic disposable 500ml water bottle returned instead of insulated stainless 750ml flask
cases.notes: Item is single-use disposable bottle, totally wrong material and SKU -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Red hand washcloth returned instead of blue microfiber bath towel
cases.notes: Wrong color, wrong dimensions (washcloth vs bath towel) -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Photographs severely out-of-focus and darkened, bottle label unreadable
cases.controlled_change: Heavy gaussian blur, extreme low light
cases.notes: Blur prevents determining cosmetic condition or fill level -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Photographs taken with extreme glare and camera motion blur across screen and chassis
cases.notes: Heavy reflection washes out screen surface; impossible to verify scratches -> pending_review.

cases.scenario: Protein tub returned completely empty with seal torn open, no powder inside
cases.notes: Empty consumable tub returned -> dispose (rule 5e).

cases.scenario: Photo shows brown shipping carton partially closed with lamp head obscured behind packing paper
cases.notes: Components obscured by brown kraft paper; identity and contents uncertain -> pending_review.
